channel.title: threat.wiki
channel.description: Threat intelligence notes, group profiles, named-person records, and defensive guidance.

item.title: ROADtools Entra ID cloud-intrusion tradecraft
item.description: Unit 42's May 2026 ROADtools analysis ties the Entra ID toolkit to nation-state cloud intrusions, covering ROADrecon discovery, roadtx token exchange, device registration persistence, Microsoft Graph enumeration, and hunting heuristics.

item.title: LiteLLM TeamPCP PyPI compromise details
item.description: Boost Security Labs' TeamPCP LiteLLM analysis adds PyPI versions 1.82.7/1.82.8, Python .pth startup execution, models.litellm.cloud exfiltration, caveated Trivy bridge hypotheses, and GitHub repository exposure/destruction behavior.

item.title: Mini Shai-Hulud expands into Intercom Packagist artifact
item.description: Socket linked Intercom's PyPI-to-npm compromise chain to a malicious Packagist intercom/intercom-php@5.0.2 artifact that abused Composer plugin install/update hooks, mutable tag metadata, Bun download, and router_runtime.js-style credential theft.

item.title: npm token reset after Mini Shai-Hulud AntV wave
item.description: Socket reported that npm invalidated all granular write tokens that bypass 2FA after the AntV Mini Shai-Hulud burst; the reset disrupts stolen token reuse but does not fix workflow-level trusted-publishing and OIDC compromise paths.

item.title: Nx Console StepSecurity technical update
item.description: StepSecurity's expanded Nx Console analysis adds the orphan commit delivery path, hidden VS Code task, Bun runtime, multi-channel exfiltration, Sigstore/SLSA abuse logic, Python kitty-monitor persistence, and host/network indicators.

item.title: Showboat Linux post-exploitation framework
item.description: Lumen Black Lotus Labs disclosed Showboat, a Linux post-exploitation framework used against telecom targets with remote shell, file transfer, process hiding, persistence, SOCKS5 proxying, port mapping, and PRC-aligned infrastructure clustering.

item.title: GitHub Actions deployment poisoning
item.description: Boost Security Labs' deployment-poisoning research documents how fork pull requests can create or influence deployment metadata and trigger secret-bearing deployment_status workflows through command injection or attacker-controlled environment URLs.

item.title: node-ipc 2026 npm maintainer-account compromise
item.description: Socket and Snyk reporting on malicious node-ipc npm versions 9.1.6, 9.2.3, and 12.0.1, likely maintainer-account abuse, CommonJS module-load execution, and credential theft.

item.title: SANDWORM_MODE AI-toolchain npm worm
item.description: Socket's SANDWORM_MODE reporting adds a Shai-Hulud-style npm typosquat worm focused on CI secrets, git hook persistence, malicious GitHub Actions, MCP prompt-injection, and AI-toolchain credential theft.

item.title: Bitwarden / Checkmarx Shai-Hulud Third Coming campaign
item.description: Unit 42's May 20 update adds April 22 TeamPCP-linked @bitwarden/cli and Checkmarx distribution-channel compromise details spanning npm, Docker Hub, GitHub Actions, and VS Code extensions.

item.title: Mini Shai-Hulud JFrog May 19 follow-up
item.description: JFrog's May 19 analysis adds optional-dependency GitHub-commit delivery, AI-tool hook persistence, kitty-monitor GitHub commit-search C2, and durabletask AWS SSM/Kubernetes lateral movement details.

item.title: TeamPCP copycat and Nx Console source-exfiltration update
item.description: GitHub confirmed poisoned Nx Console extension involvement in employee-device compromise and GitHub-internal repository exfiltration; Socket reported TeamPCP/BreachForums contest chatter that increases Shai-Hulud copycat risk.

item.title: art-template Coruna-style iOS watering-hole compromise
item.description: Socket reporting on compromised art-template npm releases that injected browser-side loaders and delivered a Coruna-style Safari/iOS watering-hole exploit framework.

item.title: shopsprint/decimal Go typosquat DNS backdoor
item.description: Socket reporting on a long-running shopspring/decimal typosquat that preserved the legitimate API while adding a Go init() DNS TXT command-execution backdoor.

item.title: Mini Shai-Hulud npm/PyPI worm campaign
item.description: Unit 42's May 20 update adds TanStack trusted-publishing abuse details, valid SLSA provenance on malicious packages, AntV scale metrics, and containment-order warnings for destructive payload behavior.

item.title: actions-cool GitHub Actions tag compromise
item.description: StepSecurity reporting on actions-cool/issues-helper and maintain-one-comment tag retargeting, imposter commits, Bun-based Runner.Worker memory scraping, and CI/CD secret exfiltration.

item.title: Webworm cloud-service C2 and proxy toolkit
item.description: Webworm 2025 activity adds Discord and Microsoft Graph C2 backdoors, GitHub staging, SoftEther VPN, and custom proxy chains across European and South African targets.

item.title: Fox Tempest malware-signing-as-a-service
item.description: Microsoft's Fox Tempest reporting covers Artifact Signing abuse, short-lived fraudulent certificates, ransomware enablement, and the OpFauxSign disruption.

item.title: TamperedChef-style productivity malware clusters
item.description: Unit 42 reporting on trojanized productivity-app clusters using malvertising, code signing, dormancy, C2, infostealers, proxy tooling, and RAT delivery.

item.title: Nx Console VS Code extension compromise
item.description: Threat-intelligence summary of the May 2026 compromised Nx Console VS Code extension, poisoned IDE-extension distribution, developer credential theft, persistence, and GitHub source-code exfiltration risk.

item.title: TeamPCP, Trivy, and CanisterWorm
item.description: Supply-chain compromise operations, tooling, and motivations.
